svg.title: Pinemoor Home: from order to doorstep
svg.desc:
Pinemoor Home: from order to doorstep What runs today, what is being built, and what comes next States shown: Live, Being built, In trial, Planned, Retiring. Solid lines: data flows today. Dotted lines: connection to build. Rollout: 1. Fraud checks in checkout (Checkout); 2. One record for each order (Order record); 3. Book returns online (Returns).
Blocks, left to right: - Where orders come from (Four ways in): Website; Mobile app; Showroom tablets (retiring); Marketplace listings (in trial). Owner: Digital team - Checkout [step 1]: Basket; Payments; Fraud checks (being built); Buy now, pay later (planned). Owner: Payments team - Order record [step 2, being built] (Every order kept in one place): map: Customer places Order; Order paid by Payment; Order includes Item; Order ships as Delivery; Item may come back as Return. example 'Example: order 10482': Customer Online account; Items Sofa, two cushions; Paid by Card, in full; Delivery Two-person, Tuesday. Owner: Platform team - Fulfilment: Warehouse: Pick and pack; Stock counts. Delivery: Two-person delivery; Same-day vans (in trial); Parcel lockers (planned). Owner: Operations - Returns [step 3, planned]: Book a collection; Refund on pickup. Owner: Not yet named - Reporting: Daily sales; Stock cover; Demand forecast (in trial). Owner: Finance - Customer service: Order lookup; Delivery changes; Chat assistant (being built). Owner: Service team Groups: - Order platform (Run by the platform team): Checkout, Order record Lines: - Where orders come from -> Checkout - Checkout -> Order record - Order record -> Fulfilment - Order record -> Returns (connection to build) - Fulfilment -> Reporting - Fulfilment -> Customer service, labeled "updates" - Returns -> Reporting (connection to build) - Where orders come from -> Reporting, labeled "Web traffic, sent nightly" - Where orders come from -> Customer service, labeled "Marketplace questions come straight to service" Note: Example. Pinemoor Home is an invented company. Every system, owner and status is made up.
